title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of a tight 1970 Fillmore set, highlighted by an epic Dark Star and soaring Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording (DP‑4) is a crystal‑clear soundboard source that many fans describe as “pristine” with only minor brightness that can be tamed with EQ. Musically the show shines – an acoustic mini‑set feeds into a powerhouse electric second set featuring Dark Star, The Other One and Lovelight, plus a monster Smokestack Lightning and a sweet Uncle John’s Band. Reviewers rave about the band’s tightness, Jerry’s soaring lead, Phil’s bass prominence and Bob Weir’s standout rhythm work.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are five‑star, praising both the performance (standout jams, tight playing) and the superb soundboard quality; consistency across >10 reviews gives high confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, pristine DP‑4 soundboard capture; a little bright but easily corrected with EQ. No dropout or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic mini‑set (Bear's Choice material) leads into a high‑energy electric set – Dark Star > The Other One > Lovelight – with seamless transitions and a tight, confident performance throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his soaring lead tone on Dark Star and overall guitar brilliance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted as playing lead‑style bass alongside Jerry, adding to the tightness of the jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted as playing at his best, providing strong rhythm and vocal work.
